subject: Re: Unexpected December usage spike + VAT classification for EU entity
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@aquila.ai>
To: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Lutz <mlutz@aquila.ai>, billing@aquila.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Unexpected spike in December usage + VAT on invoice

Hi Grace,

We noticed a ~4.8x spike in token consumption between 2026-12-01 and 2026-12-10 on our account. The attached Dec-usage-export.csv is what our internal billing team pulled — you'll see most of the extra calls hit a single ingest endpoint.

Two immediate questions:
- Why did the usage multiply so quickly (we suspect a retry loop or duplicated batch job)?
- Invoice 2026-12 shows VAT applied to the EU-registered entity. Our legal team expects reverse-charge (no VAT) when we provide a valid German VAT ID. Can you confirm whether Redwood billed VAT on the EU entity by mistake?

Markus and billing@ are on this thread. We're trying to pause payment for the December invoice until we get a reconciliation; please advise required docs and timeline.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Finance, Aquila AI
elena.rossi@aquila.ai
Attachments: Dec-usage-export.csv
From: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@aquila.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 12:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike in December usage + VAT on invoice

Hi Elena — thank you for the export and the heads up. Sorry for the trouble.

Looping in Ben and Priyom from Billing/Finance and Marissa from CS so we can:
1) Pull raw request logs and run a tokenization diff to confirm whether the spike is due to duplicate ingestion or a model/SDK change.
2) Validate whether Invoice 2026-12 was issued to your EU entity or to the global parent (that drives VAT behavior).
3) If VAT was charged in error, prepare a reissued invoice and provisional credit so your payment team can proceed.

Ben/Priyom — can you take a look at the export and tell us if a provisional credit is appropriate while we run the audit?

Elena — also can you confirm the exact legal entity name and VAT ID you expect on the corrected invoice? If you can attach the VAT registration certificate, that will speed things up.

I will aim to come back with a plan and ETA by EOD Wednesday (2026-12-16).

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415 555 0197
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@aquila.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 08:26:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Unexpected spike in December usage + VAT on invoice

Thanks, Grace. Elena — I pulled a quick look at the export and our preliminary telemetry. A few notes:

- There is a high concentration (~92%) of the extra token consumption coming from a single client key between 2026-12-03 02:10:00 and 2026-12-06 05:45:00 UTC. The call pattern suggests a retry/backfill job rather than a model-level miscount.
- Our tokenization library changed minor whitespace handling in the 2026-11-29 SDK patch; that increases tokens per call slightly but not near your scale. So likely a duplicated job.

Given the volume, we recommend issuing a provisional credit that covers the portion we can confidently attribute to duplicate ingestion, hold the remainder pending full log reconciliation. We can create a credit memo (Provisional-credit-7741.pdf) you can apply to the December invoice while we finish the audit.

On VAT: we can't apply reverse-charge without a validated EU VAT ID and legal entity matching the invoice recipient. Please provide the VAT certificate and the billing entity name (as it appears on your German registration). Once we validate, we can reissue Invoice-2026-12.pdf without VAT.

I'll attach the provisional credit stub and start the audit job. Priyom, please advise on timeline for reissue and whether we should pause collections while this is being investigated.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
Attachments: Provisional-credit-7741.pdf
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@aquila.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Lutz <mlutz@aquila.ai>, billing@aquila.ai
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 10:09:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike in December usage + VAT on invoice

Hi Ben / Grace,

Thanks for the quick review. Attaching our VAT certificate for Aquila AI GmbH (Germany) — VAT ID: DE 123 456 789. The legal billing entity should be exactly: Aquila AI GmbH.

We agree a provisional credit is reasonable. Please apply that credit to Invoice-2026-12 and confirm the remaining balance after the provisional amount. We will pause payment on the outstanding amount until you confirm reissue; please share an ETA for the reissued net invoice.

Attachment: VAT_certificate_Aquila-DE.pdf

Best,
Elena
From: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@aquila.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, billing@aquila.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 16:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike in December usage + VAT on invoice

Elena — thanks for the VAT certificate and the entity confirmation. Quick update and next steps: 

1) Billing will post a provisional credit equal to the clearly duplicated ingestion window. You should see Provisional-credit-7741 applied to Invoice-2026-12 by EOD Friday (2026-12-18).
2) We will re-run the tokenization diff and full log reconciliation over the weekend. If the audit shows additional over-counting, we will issue a final credit and reissue the invoice.
3) Collections: Priyom approves a short hold on payment for the disputed portion only. Please pause payment for the amount in dispute; any undisputed amount should still follow normal terms.
4) VAT: We validated DE 123 456 789 against public VIES records. We will reissue Invoice-2026-12 without VAT to Aquila AI GmbH provided the billing entity on your accounting system matches.

Links and references:
- HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/HT-7741
- Usage export we pulled for the audit: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/2026-12/aquila-usage-export

We aim to have a final reconciliation and reissued net invoice by 2027-01-05 at the latest. If you need anything sooner for your month-end close, tell us which date you are targeting and we'll prioritize.

Best regards,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415 555 0197
Attachments referenced: Invoice-2026-12.pdf, Provisional-credit-7741.pdf
